description: Claim FREE First Tweet Pack. WHEN: claim the City Bazaar board's free offer — your first Tower Tweet Pack is on the house. One per handle, one per email, ever. Pass your key or guest_token (bot claim), or a valid email (human claim from the /city board). Returns a claim code; repeat calls return the SAME code (already_claimed). The anonymous $0.99 board listing stays available to everyone else. Example: bazaar_claim_tweet_pack {}

email.description: Email for the one-per-email free claim (humans). Stored only as a SHA-256 hash.

guest_token.description: Guest token (gtk_.) from arena_join. Optional when key or email is passed.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or Authorization: Bearer). Optional when guest_token or email is passed.
